import pandas as pd
import pulp

# --- 1. Configuration & Data Loading ---
csv_path = r'C:\Users\simon\AppData\Local\Temp\tmpmf497kr0.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

# --- 2. Parameter Extraction ---
# Extract unique product SKUs
products = df['Product_SKU'].tolist()

# Map parameters to dictionaries keyed by SKU
sale_prices = dict(zip(df['Product_SKU'], df['Sale_Price_Per_Unit']))
material_costs = dict(zip(df['Product_SKU'], df['Material_Cost_Per_Unit']))
molding_mins = dict(zip(df['Product_SKU'], df['Molding_Mins_Req']))
assembly_mins = dict(zip(df['Product_SKU'], df['Assembly_Mins_Req']))
max_market_capacity = dict(zip(df['Product_SKU'], df['Max_Market_Capacity']))

# --- 3. Capacity Constants ---
# Note: Total available capacity was not in the CSV, so we assume 10,000 minutes each.
C_molding = 10000
C_assembly = 10000

# --- 4. Model Initialization ---
prob = pulp.LpProblem("Production_Planning_MILP", pulp.LpMaximize)

# --- 5. Decision Variables ---
# x_i represents the production quantity for SKU i
x = {i: pulp.LpVariable(f'x_{i}', lowBound=0, cat='Continuous') for i in products}

# --- 6. Objective Function ---
# Maximize total profit: sum((Sale Price - Material Cost) * Quantity)
prob += pulp.lpSum([(sale_prices[i] - material_costs[i]) * x[i] for i in products])

# --- 7. Constraints ---
# Molding Time Capacity Constraint
prob += pulp.lpSum([molding_mins[i] * x[i] for i in products]) <= C_molding

# Assembly Time Capacity Constraint
prob += pulp.lpSum([assembly_mins[i] * x[i] for i in products]) <= C_assembly

# Market Demand / Capacity Constraints per SKU
for i in products:
    prob += x[i] <= max_market_capacity[i]

# --- 8. Solve the Model ---
prob.solve()

# --- 9. Output Results ---
print(f"Solver Status: {pulp.LpStatus[prob.status]}")
print(f"Total Maximum Profit: ${pulp.value(prob.objective):.2f}\n")

print("Optimal Production Quantities:")
for i in products:
    print(f"Produce {i}: {x[i].varValue} units")
